female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

female-boilerplate-slower.title: Female borrowers who use generic template language fund more slowly.
female-boilerplate-slower.body: Pitches from women that utilize generic template language, such as standard greetings or boilerplate phrasing about inspiring others, are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-location-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a specific town or city in their pitch fund faster.
female-location-specificity-faster.body: The inclusion of a specific geographic location, such as a town, city, or city center, is associated with increased funding speed for women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
female-nwtf-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous successful loan cycles with NWTF are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-child-photo-id-slower.body: Female borrowers who include notes identifying the children in their photos may fund more slowly.

female-land-acquisition-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the concrete goal of buying a plot of land may fund faster.

female-business-success-faster.body: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.

female-child-count-slower.body: Female borrowers who specify the exact number of children they have may fund more slowly.

female-entrepreneur-phrasing-faster.body: Female borrowers who use the phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund faster.

female-past-failure-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific past failures or debts may fund more slowly.

female-traumatic-history-slower.body: Female borrowers who include narrative descriptions of traumatic personal history may fund more slowly.

female-family-future-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their children or family fund faster.

female-specific-quantities-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide highly specific quantities of supplies (e.g., kg of feed) may fund more slowly.

female-family-detail-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide descriptive detail about their family or spouse may fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-slower.title: The inclusion of gratitude markers or expressions of thanks to the lenders in the pitch text is associated with slower funding speeds for women.
